separation.shadow: in-memory semantic journal and diagnostics only
separation.onDivergence: record semanticError; do not fail an already successful authoritative save
separation.performance: raw capture receives checkpointBytes, journalBytes, eventCount and historyEffects
separation.counterfactualAnalyzer: all-state strong bytes = checkpoint JSON bytes only at samples with semanticEventCount>0; semantic/fair-known event-sourcing bytes = derived semantic journal JSON bytes. This is not actual switched-authority traffic or latency.
separation.restartCoverage: Diagnostic shadow state is stored under coop-shadow-v1:<worldId> only after an authoritative save. Restore requires exact authoritative envelope root + history length + world/owner identity. Missing, stale or corrupted diagnostics become coverage=gap; they never block game restore.
separation.persistenceOrdering: Semantic diagnostic writes are serialized in-process and awaited only during dispose; failures are reported in diagnostics and never change authoritative save success.
separation.recoveryOverlay: recoverCheckpointWithSemanticShadow is pure/non-authoritative. It keeps permitted same-life provisional fields, overlays protected identity/terminal facts, materializes missing post-checkpoint births/rebirths from recovery bases, removes noncanonical ghost actors, restores rebirthOps and raises tick/worldSeconds to protected floors.
separation.confidentialRecovery: The current reconnect token is retained only as local host recovery material; it is not public canon and must not be sent to generic validators in a stronger authority mode.
